scope: Public-safe filing source descriptor and audit pointer within the existing Cabildo preservation control and authority-discovery workspace; not a parallel communications or proceedings register.
master_link_boundary: No master proceeding identifier is assigned by this descriptor. Cabildo file 18735/2026 is identified by the source; a Commissioner claim reference and exact master-register reconciliation remain open. LZ-TRA-028/R865 and LZ-CAB-025/614 are distinct matters.

items.office: Comisionado de Transparencia y Acceso a la Información Pública
items.purpose_en: On 23 November 2026 a transparency complaint addressed to the Canary Islands Transparency Commissioner was registered through REG-AGE concerning Cabildo de Lanzarote Decree 2026-8922 and information-access file 18735/2026. The official receipt, all five submitted PDF fingerprints and the three registration-form fields were verified; the submitted attachments contain 85 pages.
items.purpose_es: El 23 de noviembre de 2026 se registró a través de REG-AGE una reclamación dirigida al Comisionado de Transparencia de Canarias relativa al Decreto 2026-8922 del Cabildo de Lanzarote y al expediente de acceso 18735/2026. Se verificaron el justificante oficial, las huellas de los cinco PDF presentados y los tres campos del formulario; los anexos presentados contienen 85 páginas.

boundaries: The new complaint remains distinct from R865/2026 and from Decree 2026-7000 / file 13817/2026.
Registration and verified attachment inclusion do not establish the Commissioner's own registry receipt, admission, internal allocation, incorporation, examination or a merits decision.
The favourable part of point 4 remains preserved. Challenging other points does not erase that part or establish unlawful or criminal conduct.
Article 262 LECrim is retained as a conditional request; no offence, guilt, personal knowledge or responsibility is transferred or treated as adjudicated.

The exact registry identifier, verification codes, personal identifiers, addresses, signatures, private provider locators and original filenames remain in restricted custody. The public source key is not an official registration number.
Earlier dated custody records and host-specific history remain intact. This descriptor does not certify universal completeness, global host parity, deployment or thread-deletion safety.
